1. Start with the monitoring records.

completion:
Calculate the average of the monitoring records.
3. Identify readings greater than three standard deviations from the average.
4. Discard data points outside the range of ± 259 nm.
5. Retain only data points between 100 nm and 240 nm.
6. Label these data points as "excessive emissions" and justify classifications based on both statistical and specified interval criteria.
